name: grok-bot
title: Grok Bot
description: Find your Grok bots, send them messages, and open their chats.
author: dcbuild3r

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Message a Bot
commands.description: Search your open Grok bots and send a message to the selected bot

commands.name: bot-wheel
commands.title: Bot Wheel
commands.description: Choose a Grok bot from an interactive radial menu

commands.name: open-chat
commands.title: Open Bot Chat
commands.description: Search your open Grok bots and jump to a chat

preferences.name: userDataPath
preferences.title: Grok Bot Data Folder
preferences.description: Optional custom Electron user-data folder containing sand-client-persistence. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Grok Bot.

preferences.name: chatWindowPosition
preferences.title: Chat Window Position
preferences.description: Where the chat window opens on the screen.

preferences.name: chatWindowSize
preferences.title: Chat Window Size
preferences.description: The size of the chat window when it opens.

preferences.name: chatTextSize
preferences.title: Chat Text Size
preferences.description: The size of text in the chat window. The rest of the chat layout scales with it.

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun --bun ray build --environment dist --output dist
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && bun --bun ray develop
